title: exotic-ccr-lean: Lean 4 Gate-0 certificates for the EXOTIC-CCR Jacobian counterexample anchor
description:
exotic-ccr-lean v0.1.1 — Lean 4 Gate-0 algebraic certificates for Project EXOTIC-CCR (Quantyra).

Proves finite exact identities for the Jacobian counterexample anchor map F : K³ → K³:

  • T0.1 — jacobianDet F = C(-2)
  • T0.2 — three-point collision F(0,0,-1/4) = F(1,-3/2,13/2) = F(-1,3/2,13/2) = (-1/4,0,0)
  • det-1 normalization G with jacobianDet G = 1 and char-2 collision packaging
  • standard non-injectivity theorems: unit Jacobian determinant does not imply injectivity over any field

Non-claims: This deposit asserts exact algebraic checks only. It does not claim full Jacobian-conjecture literature status beyond the finite identities proved; does not claim physical, operator-algebraic, channel, gate, or computational-advantage results; and does not claim Poisson/Weyl endomorphism, self-adjointness, CCR realization, or CP/dilation theorems (later EXOTIC-CCR gates).

Independent Quantyra reimplementation. Provenance credits Alpöge announcement, Cureton Lean formalization, and Speyer note without claiming those works as Quantyra products. Apache-2.0.
